```{r}
library(rlang)

ds <- ds |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    arm = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("A", arm) ~ "FOLFOX",
      grepl("D", arm) ~ "FOLFOX + Cetuximab"
    ),
    racecat = dplyr::recode(
      racecat,
      "w" = "White",
      "b" = "Black or African American",
      "oth" = "Other"
    ),
    racecat = factor(
      racecat,
      levels = c(
        "White",
        "Black or African American",
        "Other"
      )
    ),
    sex = dplyr::recode(
      sex,
      "f" = "Female",
      "m" = "Male"
    ),
    wild = dplyr::recode(
      wild,
      `1` = "Wild-type",
      `0` = "Mutant",
      `-1` = "Unknown"
    ),
    stage_g = dplyr::recode(
      stage_g,
      `1` = "T1 or T2",
      `2` = "T3",
      `3` = "T4"
    ),
    stage_g = factor(
      stage_g,
      levels = c("T1/2", "T3", "T4")
    ),
    histo_g = dplyr::recode(
      histo_g,
      `1` = "High (poorly differentiated or undifferentiated)",
      `2` = "Low (well or moderately differentiated)"
    ),
    ps = dplyr::recode(
      ps,
      `0` = "0",
      `1` = "1",
      `2` = "2"
    ),
    nodes = dplyr::recode(
      nodes,
      `1` = "1-3",
      `2` = ">=4"
    ),
    bwl_obs = dplyr::recode(
      bwl_obs,
      `1` = "Yes",
      `2` = "No"
    )
  )
custom_summary <- function(df, group_var, sum_var) {
  group_var <- rlang::ensym(group_var)
  sum_var <- rlang::ensym(sum_var)

  is_categorical <-
    is.character(df[[as_string(sum_var)]]) |
    is.factor(df[[as_string(sum_var)]])

  if (is_categorical) {
    category_lbl <-
      as_string(sum_var)
#para quitar los NA de la tabla. modificado con chatgpt
    df_out <-
      df |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!sum_var)) |> #chatgpt
      dplyr::group_by(!!group_var) |>
      dplyr::mutate(den = dplyr::n()) |> #chatgpt
      dplyr::group_by(!!group_var, !!sum_var) |>
      dplyr::summarize(
        val = dplyr::n(),
        den = unique(den),
        pct = val / den,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        id_cols = !!sum_var, names_from = !!group_var,
        values_from = c(val, den, pct)
      ) |>
      dplyr::rename(label = !!sum_var) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)),
        category = category_lbl
      )
  } else {
    category_lbl <- as_string(sum_var)

    df_out <-
      df |>
      dplyr::group_by(!!group_var) |>
      dplyr::summarize(
        n = sum(!is.na(!!sum_var)),
        mean = mean(!!sum_var, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = sd(!!sum_var, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(!!sum_var, na.rm = TRUE),
        lcl = min(!!sum_var, na.rm = TRUE),
        ucl = max(!!sum_var, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = c(mean, median), #quito n, no hace falta
        names_to = "label",
        values_to = "val"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        sd = ifelse(label == "mean", sd, NA),
        label = dplyr::recode(
          label,
          "mean" = "Mean (SD)",
          "median" = "Median (Range)"
        )
      ) |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        id_cols = label,
        names_from = !!group_var,
        values_from = c(val, sd, lcl, ucl)
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(category = category_lbl)
  }

  return(df_out)
}

ds_summary <-
   ds |>
  (\(data) purrr::map_df(
    .x = dplyr::vars(agecat,sex,racecat,nodes,wild,bmi2, bwl_obs, stage_g, histo_g, ps),
    .f = \(x) custom_summary(df = data, group_var = arm, sum_var = !!x)
  ))()
#esto lo ha hecho chatgpt:
ds_summary <- ds_summary |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = dplyr::recode(
      category,
      agecat = "Age, y",
      sex = "Sex",
      racecat = "Race",
      bmi2 = "BMI",
      wild = "KRAS",
      ps = "ECOG performance Status",
      stage_g = "Extent of invasion through bowel wall, No./total (%)",
      nodes = "Positive LNs",
      histo_g = "Histology",
      bwl_obs = "Bowel obstruction"
    )
  )

ds_summary <- ds_summary |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = dplyr::case_when(
      category == "BMI" & label == "Median (Range)" ~ "Median",
      TRUE ~ label
    )
  ) 
```
```{r}
library(gt)

ds_tbl <-
  ds_summary |>
  gt(
    rowname_col = "label",
    groupname_col = "category"
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Baseline Patient Characteristics in Primary Analysis Population" )

ds_tbl <-
  ds_tbl |>
  fmt_integer(
    columns = starts_with(c("val_")),
    rows = !(label %in% c("Mean (SD)", "Median")) #para que sean todos los valores enteros excepto media y mediana
  ) |>
  fmt_percent(
    columns = starts_with("pct_"),
    decimals = 1,
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = starts_with("val_"),
    rows = label == "Mean (SD)",
    decimals = 1
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = starts_with("sd_"),
    rows = label == "Mean (SD)",
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = starts_with("lcl_"),
    decimals = 1
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = starts_with("ucl_"),
    decimals = 1
  )|>
  fmt_number(
  columns = starts_with("val_"),
  rows = label == "Median (Range)",
  decimals = 1
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
  columns = starts_with("val_"),
  rows = label == "Median",
  decimals = 1
  )

ds_tbl <- ds_tbl |>
  cols_merge(
    columns = c("val_FOLFOX + Cetuximab", "lcl_FOLFOX + Cetuximab", "ucl_FOLFOX + Cetuximab"),
    rows = label == "Median (Range)" & category == "Age, y",
    pattern = "{1} ({2}–{3})"
  ) |>
  cols_merge(
    columns = c("val_FOLFOX", "lcl_FOLFOX", "ucl_FOLFOX"),
    rows = label == "Median (Range)" & category == "Age, y",
    pattern = "{1} ({2}–{3})"
  ) 
ds_tbl <-
  ds_tbl |>
  cols_merge(
    columns = c("val_FOLFOX + Cetuximab", "pct_FOLFOX + Cetuximab", "sd_FOLFOX + Cetuximab"),
    rows = !category %in% c(
      "Extent of invasion through bowel wall, No./total (%)"
    ),
    pattern = "<<{1}>><< ({2})>><< ({3})>>"
  ) |>
  cols_merge(
    columns = c("val_FOLFOX", "pct_FOLFOX", "sd_FOLFOX"),
    rows = !category %in% c(
      "Extent of invasion through bowel wall, No./total (%)"
    ),
    pattern = "<<{1}>><< ({2})>><< ({3})>>"
  )
ds_tbl <- ds_tbl |>
  cols_merge(
    columns = c("val_FOLFOX + Cetuximab", "den_FOLFOX + Cetuximab", "pct_FOLFOX + Cetuximab"),
    rows = category %in% c(

    ),
    pattern = "{1}/{2} ({3})"
  ) |>

ds_tbl <-
  ds_tbl |>
  tab_stub_indent(
    rows = everything(),

  ) |>
  opt_align_table_header(align = "left")
ds_tbl <-
  ds_tbl |>

### Count subjects per arm and summarize values in a list
arm_n <-
  ds |>
  dplyr::group_by(arm) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    lbl = sprintf("%s N=%i (100%%)", unique(arm), dplyr::n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(arm)

collbl_list <- as.list(arm_n$lbl)
names(collbl_list) <- paste0("val_", arm_n$arm)

ds_tbl <-
  ds_tbl |>
  cols_label(.list = collbl_list)

ds_tbl
```
